substantiveAssessment.assessment: The wrapper requires exact single-phase authority and successful same-subset, same-run predecessors. Reviewed all six supervisor controls, five control roots, phase budgets, suspended assignment, retained root identity, restricted handle inheritance, stdout/stderr files, timeout shutdown, final job-zero accounting and cleanup failures. Process receipts are published before receiptArtifact is attached to the enclosing result; build consumers bind that durable receipt.

Reviewed all nine settings roles, the two restricted Known Documents observations, source/stage/fixture snapshots, project-plugin directory and descriptor preservation, owned environment/output/DDC routes, retained partial failures and refusal of uncertain cleanup. The 20 GiB prerequisite, phase deadlines, root counts and post-operation stream/data/report caps are represented honestly; instantaneous disk or vendor allocation ceilings are not claimed. The staged-client assessment covers host copying, entry/configuration routes and preservation, without claiming a new complete review of unread legacy client implementations.

The selected dependency recipe binds the acquired pin, static Release library, C++20, /MD, compiler/toolchain/SDK selection, generated compile commands, explicit verified header/library copies and retained MIT notice. RC paths use forward slashes before CMake serialization. ModuleRules validates same-run ancestry and receipts and retains read locks through UBT exit. Vendor definitions/includes/linkage remain private to the parser dependency route. NoPCHs and -NoVFS support the strict stage-owned response and forced-definition checks.

Traced all 38 input IDs, 45 planned attempts and eight suites between manifests, native callers and wrapper validation. Reviewed typed/noexcept refusal, UE-owned input/output lifetime, five inclusive quotas, retained input bytes, primary SHA256 versus auxiliary SHA1 and evaluated check-count contracts. Compiler guards, response-chain checks, forced definitions and ledger fields support measurement without claiming A1G.

The dedicated target, disabled-by-default proof plugin, staged project and receipt policy agree.
